solver_answer.answer: Yes—taking it on appears to carry a meaningful risk of leaving you under-recovered for your already booked Sunday mediation check-in. You previously noted that facilitating a lively group gathering requires a quiet morning before you can listen carefully to someone else's conflict, and this would be a bigger Saturday-evening gathering followed by a Sunday commitment needing patient one-to-one listening. It may be safer to decline, scale back the role, or ensure the Sunday check-in can be moved and that recovery time is protected.
